standard-dialogue.player: Why are you out here on your own?

standard-dialogue.npc: I was drawn here... I use to be a traveling doctor, until I arrived in Al Kharid.
Then I heard it call to me... I immediately gave up my profession and set up here.
I'm happy here... the voices tell me I'm happy here. I can continue my work.

standard-dialogue.player: Uhh... what voices? There is no one else here.

standard-dialogue.npc: Of course there isn't, the hole you idiot, the hole speaks to me and I listen... It says I will do great things, only if I listen...

standard-dialogue.player: Well... alright then, I think I'm just going to go and leave then.

standard-dialogue-historical-dialogue.npc: Hello. What brings you to my surgery today?

steps.text: If the player is not at full health:

steps.npc: Okay, this will hurt you more than it will me.

steps.text: If the player is at full health:

options.text: What did you do before you worked here?

steps.player: What did you do before you worked here?

steps.npc: Oh, I used to be a travelling surgeon. Whenever I saw someone have an accident, I'd be there to check for concussion and offer treatment.
It was a worthy cause, but I didn't feel properly appreciated, so I retired. Then I got bored, so I came to work here.
So can I help you with something?
